Subject: Draft: Surge invite segmentation + RSVP reminder flow

Team —

Attaching the draft invite copy and the segmentation sheet for the surge wave we discussed. Goal: 3-touch email sequence + 2 reminder SMS (where opted-in) targeting:
- Priority: existing paid customers (renewal window + usage signal)
- High intent: demo requests past 30 days
- Engineers: GitHub/StackOverflow engagement tags

Asks:
1) Copy sanity check — subject line variants included in the doc (invite-copy-v3.docx). Please highlight any phrasing that sounds too vendory for engineers.
2) Segmentation review — confirm the filter on "avg tokens per request > 250" in segmentation-sheet-q4.csv.
3) Tracking links — Mateo, can you generate UTM rows and deliver the tracking-links-utm.xlsx by EOD Monday? We need per-segment UTMs and link shorteners for partner co-mail.

Proposed cadence (short):
- Invite (Day 0)
- Reminder 1 (Day 3)
- Reminder 2 (Day 7) + calendar hold
- Last-chance (6 hours)

I left a Doc with subject A/B tests and a rough RSVP cadence here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aInvitesDraft

Attachments: invite-copy-v3.docx, segmentation-sheet-q4.csv

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Monica — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes inline and a few broader asks: 

- Subject lines: I prefer the more technical variant for engineers ("Scaling LLM inference: practical patterns from production") — less hype, more signal.
- Body: move the "what you'll learn" bullets above the CTA for engineers; they skim.
- CTA: change "Reserve your seat" to "Claim a developer seat" for the engineer segment; keeps CTR high in previous tests.

Segmentation: the token filter looks fine but add a recency window (active in last 60 days) to keep list fresh.

Tracking: can we add a hidden param for mail stream (ms=surge-wave-1) so we can attribute to the surge? Also add a partner_id param for co-mail.

I'll flag a small edit in invite-copy-v3.docx and send a redline.

Subject: Re: Draft: Surge invite segmentation + RSVP reminder flow — reminder cadence + SMS opt-in

Quick cadence recommendation based on recent open/CTR patterns for engineers & customers: 
- Invite Day 0: send at 10:30am local (higher open for engineers)
- Reminder 1 Day 2: short reminder, include a code snippet example in the email (very high lift for devs)
- Reminder 2 Day 5: calendar hold + one-click add to calendar in the header
- Last-chance 6 hrs: subject = "Seats filling: last chance to join"

SMS: include single opt-in link with short copy and clear opt-out. Only send SMS to customers with phone on file and high usage signal. Two SMS touches: Day 1 (invite follow) and Day 5 (last-chance).

Also: Priyom, can you coordinate a small canary send to ~1k devs on Thursday to validate subject A variant and the code snippet? If performance looks good (>18% open, >3.5% click) we scale.
